existing_module_scope: Keep literal bar and whole-event references. Repair the four collected public configuration/restore/boundedness issues together with the new batch; preserve existing named semantics and callers.
input: Immutable eligible Trade/TradeView records from F05, raw instrument and measurement/filter definition, F03 explicit half-open windows/reset identities, F06 positive coverage and watermark evidence; distinct typed quote observations.
outputs: Exact price OHLC, V/count/priced and unpriced V, sum(pV), sum(p²V), signed/unknown mass, order/coverage status, relative CVD increment and extrema with named opening anchor.
Immutable final/provisional/reset-partial materializations with actual completion, event/interval/definition identity and complete correction dependency lineage.
Separate typed quote and opaque supplied-bar summaries which cannot invent traded mass or within-bar sequence.
Explicit allocation records retain one original event and no new independent trade identity.

composition.price_volume: V=A.V+B.V; PV=A.PV+B.PV; P2V=A.P2V+B.P2V on equal raw units/measure. Partial priced support is reported separately.
composition.ordered_cvd: d=A.d+B.d; high=max(A.high,A.d+B.high); low=min(A.low,A.d+B.low), including initial zero. Exact only with positive history, known signs and proved order, including cross-block timestamp ties.
composition.ohlc: Chronologically ordered endpoints and max/min extrema. If edge ties lack order, retain exact common price only when all tied prices agree; otherwise edge unknown. Interior tie ambiguity blocks sequence-dependent consumers.
composition.nonmergeable: No generic exact composition for quantiles, rebinned profiles, changing-anchor deviations, conditional probabilities, hidden vendor transforms or constituent body envelope from one opaque aggregate.

materialization: One capture/source pass produces shared bounded event blocks/summaries. Independent literal traversal is a separate reference. Time windows may query shared blocks; count/volume/range builders receive one whole-event pass. No branch may derive several independent events from one print.

activity_rules.volume: first whole event reaches or exceeds frozen contract-volume threshold
activity_rules.events: first whole event reaches frozen unique-original-event threshold
activity_rules.range: first whole event reaches/exceeds frozen high-minus-low tick threshold
activity_rules.reset: close nonempty pending bar as explicit reset-partial, then start new named epoch
activity_rules.ambiguous_order_or_range_price: unavailable ordered partition, while independent time/mass summaries keep supported quantities
activity_rules.allocations: separate complete exact allocation plan; sum equals original size; original clocks and independent-event cardinality remain unchanged

causality_and_restore: Freeze every captured input prefix and request/evidence version. Publication >= captured cut and all required inputs/close/watermark. Preserve old publications through late correction and same-cut later admission. Checkpoint retains reproducible input history/request/support; rebuild and compare canonical derived content before accepting restoration.

bounds.policy: Exact immutable positive bounds; overflow refuses atomically, no silent eviction or configuration mutation.

reference: Independent scalar arithmetic/traversal from original toy records; never calls challenger summary merge, materializer, selection or restore computation. Sharing immutable input/output type contracts is allowed.

retain: actual build/query CPU and wall time
peak process RSS and retained state counts
comparison.acceptance: exact arithmetic/prefix/restart/fault invariants and declared bounded work; no universal runtime speedup required from one toy timing

remaining: Native supplied/recomputed matching by actual raw instrument/filter/source semantics; all named source variants remain individually open.
Threshold learning is C05; all fitted calibrations/OOF/held-out predictive and economic comparisons remain gated.
Real receipt replay, external projections, all-source consumer integration and future monitoring are not replaced by these deterministic fixtures.
